# Sirach Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 2 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_002_page_001.jpg

---

**1** My child, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare yourself for trials.

**2** Set your heart straight and be resolute; do not be hasty in a time of calamity.

**3** Cling to him and do not turn away, so that you may be exalted at the end of your days.

**4** Accept whatever comes your way, and in the changes that bring you low, be patient.

**5** For gold is tested in fire, and acceptable people in the furnace of humiliation.

**6** Trust in him and he will help you; straighten your paths and hope in him.

**7** You who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy; do not stray from him lest you fall.

**8** You who fear the Lord, trust him, and your reward will not fail to come.

**9** You who fear the Lord, hope for what is good — for everlasting gladness and mercy.

**10** Look to the ancient generations and see: who has ever trusted in the Lord and been put to shame? Who has persevered in the fear of him and been abandoned? Who has called on him and been ignored?

**11** For the Lord is compassionate and merciful; he forgives sins and rescues in the time of trouble.

**12** Woe to faint hearts and faltering hands, and to the sinner who walks two ways.

**13** Woe to the despairing heart, which has no faith — therefore it will find no shelter.

**14** Woe to you who have lost your endurance! What will you do when the Lord comes to reckon with you?

**15** Those who fear the Lord do not defy his words; those who love him keep his ways.

**16** Those who fear the Lord seek his favor; those who love him are filled with his law.

**17** Those who fear the Lord prepare their hearts and humble their souls in his presence.

**18** Let us fall into the hands of the Lord rather than into the hands of mortals; for as his greatness is, so too is his mercy.
